also: something will turn up, I hope

terms.gloss: something will turn up, something will happen
evidence: Ter. And. 2.1.14: intereā fīet aliquid, spērō (Lewis & Short s.v. spērō)
terms.comment: Literally “something will be done (will come about)”: fīō as the passive of faciō.

phrases.english: meanwhile something will turn up, I hope

sources: Lewis & Short: spero
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 110.
